note: Vietnam's largest banks are the state banks (Vietcombank, BIDV, VietinBank, Agribank) and the large private banks (Techcombank, VPBank, MB, VIB, among the biggest card issuers). VIB's other cards' fee pages answered a 'Challenge Validation' page on 2026-10-30, which this research doesn't pass; VPBank's card page states no fee figures and Vietcombank's and Techcombank's card fee pages weren't found in this pass; so only VIB's One Card is written. VIB's fees and conditions for its One Card (read again 2026-10-30): the card has three tiers set by the holder's limit (Signature above 100 million dong, Platinum above 50 million up to 100 million, Gold up to 50 million), each written as a card (the Gold this file has held since 2026-10-29 is kept): the principal card's annual fee 2,999,000, 1,999,000 or 999,000 dong; purchases and cash 2.54% to 3.71% a month by credit history (cash drawn at a VIB branch POS 1.88% to 2.96%, not written); up to 55 days free of interest on purchases (the due date is 25, 20 or 15 days after the statement by tier; 55 is written for every tier); a cash advance 2.5%, 3% or 3.5%, at least 100,000 dong; spending in another currency 1%, 3% or 3.5% (the Signature's free for its first three statements, not written); over the limit 4% of the excess; a late payment 4%, 5% or 6% of the whole unpaid statement balance, at least 50,000 and at most 2,000,000 dong. A metal card's 1,500,000-dong issue fee and the design fees aren't written; the standard card is issued free. The page states no minimum payment.
